q: Potash alum ($K_2SO_4 \cdot Al_2(SO_4)_3 \cdot 24H_2O$) can be used in water purification, leather tanning and _____.
e: Potash alum (K_2SO_4 · Al_2(SO_4)_3 · 24H_2O) can be used in water purification, leather tanning and dyeing. Listen for dyeing in that sentence.

q: Lead(II,IV) oxide (Red lead, $Pb_3O_4$) can be used for _____.
e: Lead(II,IV) oxide (Red lead, Pb_3O_4) can be used for surface coating. LeadII,IV oxide Red lead, Pb_3O_4 can be used.

q: Bordeaux mixture, a suspension of copper(II) sulphate ($CuSO_4$) and calcium hydroxide ($Ca(OH)_2$), is used to control _____ on grapes, melons and other berries.
e: Bordeaux mixture, a suspension of copper(II) sulphate (CuSO_4) and calcium hydroxide (Ca(OH)_2), is used to control fungus on grapes, melons and other berries. Copper(II) sulphate solution is a common electrolyte, and hydrated CuSO4·5H2O is blue.

q: Brass finds uses in jewellery, machine bearings, electrical connections, door and _____.
e: Brass finds uses in jewellery, machine bearings, electrical connections, door and furniture. Listen for furniture in that sentence.

q: Bronze is widely used in castings and _____ parts.
e: Bronze is widely used in castings and machine parts. Bronze is widely used in castings and parts.

q: Stainless steel is hard and rustproof. This is used for cutlery and equipment in _____ factories.
e: Stainless steel is hard and rustproof. This is used for cutlery and equipment in chemical factories.
